title: Ztracená rukavice
desc: Anetě se při koulování ztratí rukavice. Ráno ji najde — v ruce sněhuláka.
desc_en: Annie loses a mitten in a snowball fight. In the morning she finds it, in the snowman's hand.
world: a snowy village park in winter, snow-covered trees, a wooden bench, gentle snowfall, soft blue and white colors
setting: Zasněžený vesnický park v zimě: zapadané stromy, dřevěná lavička, jemné sněžení a modrobílé barvy.
music: cozy winter children's music, sleigh bells, celesta and soft piano, gentle and magical, instrumental, 90 bpm

annie.name: Aneta
annie.desc: a lively 7-year-old girl with long blond hair under a white knitted hat with a pompom, rosy cheeks, a purple winter coat, a pink scarf and red knitted mittens
annie.look: Živá sedmiletá holčička s dlouhými blond vlasy pod bílou pletenou čepicí s bambulí, s růžovými tvářemi, ve fialovém kabátku, s růžovou šálou a červenými pletenými rukavicemi.

snowman.name: sněhulák
snowman.desc: a friendly round snowman with a carrot nose, coal eyes and a coal smile, two stick arms and a small black top hat
snowman.look: Přátelský kulatý sněhulák s mrkví místo nosu, uhlíkovýma očima a úsměvem, s rukama z klacíků a malým černým cylindrem.

shots.action: Aneta stojí v zasněženém parku, chytá vločky na červené rukavice a s úsměvem se dívá nahoru.
shots.keyframe: Annie stands in the snowy park catching snowflakes on her red mittens
shots.motion: Annie holds out her hands, snowflakes land on her red mittens, she looks up and smiles
shots.narration: Napadl první sníh. Aneta běžela ven.
shots.narration_en: The first snow fell. Annie ran outside.

shots.action: Aneta nabere sníh, uplácá kouli a hodí ji daleko. Směje se, udělá další a hodí znovu.
shots.keyframe: Annie throws a snowball in the snowy park, laughing
motion: Annie scoops up snow, pats it into a ball and throws it far
Annie laughs, bends down, makes another snowball and throws it
shots.narration: Koulovala se, až jí čepice sjela do očí.
shots.narration_en: She threw snowballs until her hat slipped over her eyes.

shots.action: Aneta udiveně zírá na holou ruku, jedna červená rukavice chybí. Zavrtí zmrzlými prsty a rozhlíží se.
shots.keyframe: Annie looks at her bare right hand in surprise, one red mitten is missing
shots.motion: Annie looks at her bare hand, wiggles her cold fingers and looks around

shots.action: Aneta klečí v hlubokém sněhu, hrabe v něm oběma rukama a pak zavrtí hlavou.
shots.keyframe: Annie kneels in the deep snow and digs in it with her hands
shots.motion: Annie digs in the snow with both hands, looks, then shakes her head
shots.narration: Hledala a hledala, ale nenašla ji.
shots.narration_en: She searched and searched, but couldn't find it.

shots.action: Aneta zapíchne mrkev do obličeje sněhuláka, kterého právě postavila, couvne a zatleská.
shots.keyframe: Annie puts a carrot nose on the snowman she has just built in the park
shots.motion: Annie pushes the carrot nose into the snowman's face, steps back and claps
shots.narration_en: So she built a snowman instead.

shots.action: Za soumraku Aneta zamává sněhulákovi a jde domů s jednou holou rukou v kapse. Padá sníh.
shots.keyframe: Annie waves goodbye to the snowman in the park as evening falls, one bare hand in her pocket
shots.motion: Annie waves at the snowman and walks away towards home while snow falls
shots.narration: Domů šla s rukou v kapse.
shots.narration_en: She went home, one hand in her pocket.

shots.action: V noci pod měsícem stojí sněhulák sám v prázdném parku. Klacíková ruka s červenou rukavicí se pomalu zvedne a uhlíkové oči zajiskří.
shots.keyframe: at night under the moon, the snowman stands alone in the empty park holding a red mitten on one stick arm
motion: the moon shines, snow sparkles, the snowman's stick arm with the red mitten slowly lifts
the snowman's coal eyes twinkle and it seems to smile at the moon
shots.narration: V noci se v parku dělo kouzlo. Sněhulák držel červenou rukavici!
shots.narration_en: At night, magic happened. The snowman was holding a red mitten!

shots.action: Ráno Aneta přiběhne do parku, zastaví se a podívá se ke sněhulákovi.
shots.keyframe: in the morning Annie runs into the snowy park in her purple coat
shots.motion: Annie runs into the park, stops and looks towards the snowman
shots.narration_en: In the morning, Annie ran to the park.

shots.action: Aneta sundá červenou rukavici ze sněhulákovy klacíkové ruky, vydechne a usměje se.
shots.keyframe: Annie finds her red mitten on the snowman's stick hand, the snowman smiles
shots.motion: Annie takes the red mitten from the snowman's stick hand, gasps and smiles
shots.narration_en: Her mitten! The snowman had found it.

shots.action: Aneta v obou rukavicích tančí před sněhulákem radostné kroky do strany.
shots.keyframe: Annie stands in the snowy park in front of the snowman, both red mittens on, happy
shots.motion: Annie dances happy side steps on the spot, stepping left and right and swinging her arms, same purple coat, same snowy park
shots.narration: Aneta radostí tancovala a sněhulák se usmíval.
shots.narration_en: Annie danced for joy, and the snowman smiled.

shots.action: Aneta omotá sněhulákovi kolem krku svou růžovou šálu, zaváže ji a poplácá ho.
shots.keyframe: Annie wraps her pink scarf around the snowman's neck
shots.motion: Annie wraps her scarf around the snowman's neck, ties it and pats it
shots.narration: Na poděkování mu dala svou šálu.
shots.narration_en: To say thanks, she gave him her scarf.

shots.action: V prosluněném zasněženém parku Aneta objímá sněhuláka. Sníh se třpytí a ona se směje do kamery.
shots.keyframe: Annie hugs the snowman in the sunny snowy park
shots.motion: Annie hugs the snowman, snow sparkles in the sun, she looks at the camera and laughs
shots.narration: Od té doby byli nejlepší kamarádi.
shots.narration_en: From then on, they were best friends.
